from tools import search_hotels, search_attractions, filter_hotels, filter_attractions, save_to_cache, get_results_from_cache

# Retrieve cached hotel and attraction results
hotels_result = get_results_from_cache(key="hotels")
attractions_result = get_results_from_cache(key="attractions")

# Filter hotels based on user's amenity preferences (gym and wifi)
filtered_hotels = filter_hotels(
    prior_results=hotels_result,
    gym_present=True,
    free_wifi_included=True
)

# Save the filtered hotel results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_hotels", value=filtered_hotels)

# Filter attractions based on user's preference (Art type and specific name)
filtered_attractions = filter_attractions(
    prior_results=attractions_result,
    type=["Art"],
    attraction_name=["Saguaro National Park"]
)

# Save the filtered attraction results to cache
save_to_cache(key="filtered_attractions", value=filtered_attractions)

# Find the nearest attractions to the filtered hotels
nearest_results = search_nearest(
    hotels=filtered_hotels,
    attractions=filtered_attractions,
    groupBy="hotel"
)

# Save the nearest results to cache
save_to_cache(key="nearest_hotels_attractions", value=nearest_results)
